name: onebrain
description: Your organization's shared memory: recall decisions, commitments and who knows what, with sources.
long_description: OneBrain turns your team's email, meetings, calendar and boards into one searchable memory. This extension gives Claude the recall and remember tools for it. It is built for you personally: your token is inside, so there is nothing to sign in to.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search the organization's memory; every answer carries its sources.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save a fact, decision or commitment to the shared memory.

tools.name: list_memory
tools.description: Browse recent facts by source, person or topic.

tools.name: graph_neighbors
tools.description: What connects to a person, project or topic.

tools.name: who_knows
tools.description: Who on the team knows about something, ranked by the facts that prove it.
